entities.summary: Colonel George Thomas Clark was a British surgeon and engineer. He was particularly associated with the management of the Dowlais Iron Company. He was also an antiquary and historian of Glamorgan. George Thomas Clark was a architects & engineers from Chelsea (1809-05-26, Chelsea–1898-04-06). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
